senses.gloss: m. (גדם) one whose hand or fingers are cut off or stumped.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 8:4">Snh. VIII, 4</cite>; Y. ib. VIII, 26ᵇ top; a. e.—Fem. <he>גִּידֶּמֶת</he>, <he>גִּדֶּ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 12:6:6">Y. Yeb. XII, 13ᵃ</cite> top; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 81">Gen. R. s. 81</cite>, beg.
<cite ref="Shabbat 53b:20">Sabb. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>אשה ג׳</he> a woman with a stumped finger.—
<cite ref="Chullin 79a">Ḥull. 79ᵃ</cite> <he>גידמת</he> an animal whose tail and ears are lopped off. Cmp. <cite ref="S00785"><he>קִיטֵּם</he></cite>.
